description: This file defines an interface for handling user interactions in a recycler view, specifically for note items. It declares methods for item click and long click events, passing the item position and view binding to the handlers.

classes.name: NoteRecyclerListener
classes.description: An interface for listening to note item click and long click events in a recycler view.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Callback for when a note item is clicked, providing the position and view binding.

methods.name: onLongClick
methods.description: Callback for when a note item is long-pressed, providing the position and view binding, returning a boolean to indicate if the event was handled.
